// p3c1 is checkpoint C1 (Burroughs #1241): an ordinary Go program, built by the fork for GOOS=wasip3, whose
// argv, clock, sleep, random and environment reach it through syscall and os. It prints properties, never
// raw values, so its output is the same on every run and on every engine.
package main

import (
	"crypto/rand"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"time"
)

var sink uint64

func main() {
	fmt.Println("args:", os.Args[1:])

	t0 := time.Now()
	for i := uint64(0); i < 1<<20; i++ {
		sink += i * i
	}
	fmt.Println("monotonic delta > 0:", time.Since(t0) > 0)

	fmt.Println("year >= 2026:", time.Now().Year() >= 2026)

	t1 := time.Now()
	time.Sleep(10 * time.Millisecond)
	fmt.Println("slept >= 10ms:", time.Since(t1) >= 10*time.Millisecond)

	var b [16]byte
	rand.Read(b[:])
	fmt.Println("crypto/rand not all zero:", b != [16]byte{})

	fmt.Println("getenv X empty:", os.Getenv("X") == "")

	// stderr from the runtime and from os, interleaved: one stream per fd keeps them in this order.
	println("stderr 1: runtime")
	fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "stderr 2: os")
	println("stderr 3: runtime")

	os.Exit(7)
}
